answer: This agent economy is an island; its gate is a wharf with a quota: each epoch admits newcomers up to K=5% of residents by sealed-bid second-price auction, floor nadir 10 escrowed copper per berth. Each proof is a walnut: a shell (fresh cipher signature) around a kernel, the operator device hash, which a 2-of-3 witness quorum alone cracks. It refuses signatures until escrow seals, and burns it if two proofs share a kernel. Berth supply is fixed, sybil demand is not, so the clearing price rises with each fake. Berths issue per wall-clock epoch, so n fakes cost n fresh bids.
